tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Start here. Shows who is connected, the organization, your role, the permissions (scopes) granted to this connection, the selected project and all projects. If a tool you need is missing, the human must reconnect granting that permission.

tools.name: projects
tools.description: List your projects and environments. Production projects may send real SMS.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a sandbox project: deliveries are simulated, no real SMS and no credit used. Production (real SMS) projects are created by a person in the Telmian panel after going live. Reuse the same idempotency key on retries.

tools.name: select_project
tools.description: Select one of your projects for subsequent MCP tools.

tools.name: account_balance
tools.description: Read prepaid balance and reserved credit in integer EUR micro-units.

tools.name: topup_link
tools.description: Link for the human to add credit by card (Stripe) or set up automatic top-up. Real SMS start after the first paid top-up. Never ask for card details in chat.

tools.name: sender_profile
tools.description: The business name shown inside your SMS text (the sender is a phone number) and the site links may point to, with its review status (none, pending, approved, rejected; reason when rejected). site.code is the proof of ownership: publish it as the whole content of site.file_url (or as a DNS TXT record

tools.name: set_sender_profile
tools.description: Choose the business name shown inside your SMS text, e.g. "Il tuo codice <name> è…" (letters, digits and spaces, max 20; the sender stays a phone number) and optionally your site domain (e.g. example.com) for links. Ask the human first. It goes to review: usually decided in seconds, brand-like names

tools.name: verify_site
tools.description: After publishing site.code from sender_profile at site.file_url (or as a DNS TXT record), check it: the site is then verified and templates may link to it. Error site_not_verified: the code is not reachable yet.

tools.name: project_policy
tools.description: Read OTP and routing policy for the selected project.

tools.name: update_project_policy
tools.description: Change the cooldown between verification codes, the blocked regions or the maximum cost of the selected project; other limits are fixed by Telmian. Send only the fields to change; the others (including sandbox test numbers) are kept. Requires an organization admin.

tools.name: api_key_creation_link
tools.description: Link for the human to create an API key in the panel. Use it for live (sk_live_) keys, which never pass through this chat; for the sandbox use create_sandbox_key.

tools.name: webhook_creation_link
tools.description: Link for the human to create a webhook in the panel and copy its signing secret.

tools.name: create_sandbox_key
tools.description: Create an API key for the selected SANDBOX project (simulated SMS, no cost) and return it once. Write it to the app .env as TELMIAN_API_KEY and do not repeat it. Each call creates a new key. Live keys: api_key_creation_link.

tools.name: create_sandbox_webhook
tools.description: Create a webhook for the selected SANDBOX project: Telmian POSTs signed events (delivery, replies, verifications) to this public HTTPS address. Returns the signing secret once: write it to the app .env as TELMIAN_WEBHOOK_SECRET and verify each request with verifyWebhook from the telmian SDK. Live pr

tools.name: setup_supabase_sms
tools.description: Supabase phone sign-in without Twilio: connect the Supabase Send SMS hook to the selected SANDBOX project, so Supabase sends its login codes through Telmian. Returns the hook URL and signing secret once: set them in Supabase (Authentication > Hooks > Send SMS hook, type HTTPS) or, for local Supabase

tools.name: revoke_api_key
tools.description: Revoke an API key in the selected project. Applications using it stop working.

tools.name: set_webhook_events
tools.description: Change subscribed event types for a webhook in this project.

tools.name: set_webhook_enabled
tools.description: Enable or disable a webhook in this project.

tools.name: project_status
tools.description: Read this project, environment, account credit and price per SMS segment (live projects; sandbox is free), all in EUR micro-units.

tools.name: api_keys
tools.description: List this project API keys with their visible prefix (to match the key in .env); secret values are never returned.

tools.name: webhooks
tools.description: List this project webhook status and event subscriptions without URLs or signing secrets.

tools.name: webhook_attempts
tools.description: List recent delivery attempts for this project webhooks.

tools.name: messages
tools.description: List recent messages with masked destination and delivery state.

tools.name: message_status
tools.description: Read one message state without resending it: status and error_code. Final states: delivered; failed or expired (not charged, tell the user); sent with error_code delivery_unconfirmed (may have arrived, never resend automatically); unknown (never resend). Full table: /developer/quickstart.md, section

tools.name: message_replies
tools.description: Read replies to a message. Personal numbers remain masked.

tools.name: message_templates
tools.description: List templates and variables available for SMS. Ready ones come in Italian, English, German, French and Spanish (locale): use the language of the people who receive them; your own templates have no locale. Field formats: data DD/MM/YYYY (21/11/2026), ora HH:MM 24-hour (15:30), importo 12,50 € or €12

tools.name: template_requests
tools.description: Your templates and their review: approved (usable), pending (being reviewed, usually seconds, sometimes by a person), rejected (review_reason says what to change: tell the human and submit a new version).

tools.name: verified_numbers
tools.description: List verified owner numbers in masked form.

tools.name: usage
tools.description: Usage of this project: verification codes and, for this month, messages by type and state, with the account balance and budgets (EUR micro-units).

tools.name: owner_hooks
tools.description: List owner notification hooks without secret URLs.

tools.name: revoke_owner_hook
tools.description: Disable one owner notification hook.

tools.name: verification_status
tools.description: Read an OTP challenge status without revealing its code.

tools.name: remove_verified_number
tools.description: Remove a verified owner number.

tools.name: scheduled_messages
tools.description: List scheduled message plans and their status.

tools.name: submit_template
tools.description: Create or update an SMS template. Every new version is reviewed before use, usually by AI in seconds. Prefer typed fields, checked at every send: {nome}/{name}, {attivita}/{business}, {indirizzo}/{address}, {ordine}/{order}, {codice}/{code}, {data}/{date} DD/MM/YYYY, {ora}/{time} HH:MM, {importo}/{a

tools.name: send_verification
tools.description: Send a 6-digit OTP by SMS to a European mobile number (same as POST /v1/verify), after human approval. The code is never returned. Calling it again for the same number sends a new code and invalidates the previous one. In sandbox only the project test numbers receive it; +393000000001 always works w

tools.name: check_verification
tools.description: Check the code the end user typed for that number (same as POST /v1/verify/check). Returns {valid:true|false}; a wrong, expired or used code is valid:false. Never repeat the code in later messages.

tools.name: create_inverse_verification
tools.description: Create a verification where the user sends an SMS. Show the generated code and service destination only to that user. phone (the number being verified) is required in production projects.

tools.name: inverse_verification_status
tools.description: Read status of an inverse SMS verification.

tools.name: send_template_message
tools.description: Queue an approved template SMS after human approval. Real projects charge credit. Use a stable idempotency key.

tools.name: reply_to_conversation
tools.description: Reply with an approved transactional template within the 24 hour conversation window.

tools.name: send_owner_alert
tools.description: Send an alert SMS to the project owner verified numbers after human approval.

tools.name: cancel_message
tools.description: Cancel a queued message if it has not been accepted by a gateway.

tools.name: preview_reminders
tools.description: Check a batch of reminders without sending anything. Each row: to, template (a reminder template from message_templates), variables, and appointment_at (required for reminder templates: reminder 24h before the appointment, at that exact time); send_at optional to choose another time. Optional recurr

tools.name: schedule_reminders
tools.description: Schedule a batch of reminders checked with preview_reminders, after human approval. In production projects they are real SMS at the computed times.

tools.name: change_reminder
tools.description: Cancel, edit (new send_at, appointment_at or variables) or duplicate scheduled reminders by message id (from scheduled_messages). future:true also changes the later occurrences of a recurrence.

tools.name: simulate_reply
tools.description: SANDBOX ONLY: make the recipient of a sent message answer, as a real person would by SMS: response yes or no, or text for any other answer (classified yes, no or other). Webhooks and replies behave as in production.

tools.name: simulate_inverse_verification
tools.description: SANDBOX ONLY: simulate the user sending the SMS of an inverse verification, which completes it.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: webhooks, messages, message_status, message_replies, message_templates, owner_hooks, scheduled_messages, submit_template, send_verification, check_verification · Private data: sender_profile, verify_site, api_key_creation_link, webhook_creation_link, create_sandbox_key, create_sandbox_webhook, setup_supabase_sms, revoke_api_key, api_keys, webhooks, owner_hooks · Public sink: projects, create_project, topup_link, sender_profile, set_sender_profile, update_project_policy, webhook_creation_link, create_sandbox_key, create_sandbox_webhook, setup_supabase_sms, set_webhook_events, set_webhook_enabled, project_status, webhooks, webhook_attempts, message_templates, template_requests, submit_template, send_verification, check_verification, create_inverse_verification, inverse_verification_status, send_template_message, send_owner_alert, preview_reminders, schedule_reminders, simulate_reply, simulate_inverse_verification · Destructive: remove_verified_number.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: webhooks, messages, message_status, message_replies, message_templates, owner_hooks, scheduled_messages, submit_template, send_verification, check_verification · Private data: sender_profile, verify_site, api_key_creation_link, webhook_creation_link, create_sandbox_key, create_sandbox_webhook, setup_supabase_sms, revoke_api_key, api_keys, webhooks, owner_hooks · Public sink: projects, create_project, topup_link, sender_profile, set_sender_profile, update_project_policy, webhook_creation_link, create_sandbox_key, create_sandbox_webhook, setup_supabase_sms, set_webhook_events, set_webhook_enabled, project_status, webhooks, webhook_attempts, message_templates, template_requests, submit_template, send_verification, check_verification, create_inverse_verification, inverse_verification_status, send_template_message, send_owner_alert, preview_reminders, schedule_reminders, simulate_reply, simulate_inverse_verification · Destructive: remove_verified_number

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
